params.prompt: VO: 'the tighter you grip someone you fear losing, the faster they slip away'. SCENE: evening playground sandbox, navy-blue dusk sky with a low orange sun. The MASCOT stands in the sandbox, facing the viewer, holding his right fist up at chest height squeezing sand; a clear stream of sand pours out from the bottom of his fist onto the ground. Far behind him the GIRLFRIEND walks away toward the right, small, seen from the side. ONE ACTION: sand pouring from the squeezed fist. Dry sand = pale beige/ivory grains with small gold highlights, drawn as tiny round pixel grains.  CAST (copy from the cast reference sheet): MASCOT = black hair, navy suit jacket, white shirt, orange tie, navy trousers (first sprite). GIRLFRIEND = long dark-brown hair, golden-yellow top, brown skirt (second sprite). Only these characters unless stated. STYLE (must match the reference images): 16-bit retro pixel-art game scene, vertical 9:16 phone frame. Chunky, clearly visible square pixels on a consistent grid (the whole image looks like ~216x384 pixel art scaled up with nearest-neighbour), clean 1-pixel dark ink outlines (#0C0E1A), flat colour fills with 1-2 step pixel shading, clear light from the upper left. Colours ONLY from the channel palette in the palette reference: warm orange #F58A24, wooden brown #805638, midnight navy #172442, muted pixel blue #294575, warm beige #E2C4A0, golden yellow #F0BA3C, soft ivory #F5E8C9, ink #0C0E1A, red #E82A2A (plus darker/lighter tints of these). Roughly 60% dominant colour, 30% secondary, 10% orange-gold accent. Characters are simple chibi sprites exactly like the cast reference sheet (big head, dot eyes, small body, mitten-like hands with a visible thumb, hands always attached to arms). Detail hierarchy: characters simple; the main object of the scene drawn with MORE pixel detail so its real-world structure is instantly recognisable. Simple uncluttered background, main subject large and centred in the upper two-thirds of the frame; keep the bottom 20% calm and plain (subtitles go there). Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or UI in the image.
